findings.evidence: 'Use when asked to "explain PR changes", "open or refresh the PR summary", "promote develop to main", or "reuse merged PR bodies".' has no intent-level trigger for users who just want a PR opened
findings.fix: Create or update the GitHub pull request for the current branch from its committed diff: summary, changeset triage, optional Mermaid or draw.io diagram, promotion-branch bodies (develop, staging, main) reused from merged PRs, and reviewers. Use when asked to open, write, refresh or describe a pull request, "explain PR changes", promote develop or staging to main, or reuse merged PR bodies, even without the word "PR summary". Pushes feature branches and writes PRs. Not for a read-only explanation of a diff (use explain-changes-mental-model).

findings.evidence: The head == base guard creates 'pr/<short-slug>' from main and continues, but no branch covers an empty 'origin/$base...HEAD' diff, where gh pr create fails only after the push
findings.fix: Add a check after the base fetch: when `git rev-list --count "origin/$base..HEAD"` is 0, stop with `no commits between <base> and <head>` before any gh pr create. Delete the just-pushed branch only if this run created it.
